description: This file defines a storage mechanism for push relay registration states and related key IDs using the Keychain, including loading, saving, and clearing stored data. It includes a data structure for registration state and functions to manage persistence and retrieval of keys and registration information.

methods.name: loadRegistrationState
methods.description: Loads the registration state from Keychain, decoding JSON data into a RegistrationState object.

methods.name: saveRegistrationState
methods.description: Encodes a RegistrationState object into JSON and saves it to Keychain.

methods.name: clearRegistrationState
methods.description: Deletes the registration state entry from Keychain.

methods.name: loadAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored App Attest Key ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Stores the App Attest Key ID into Keychain.

methods.name: clearAppAttestKeyID
methods.description: Removes the App Attest Key ID from Keychain.

methods.name: loadAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored Attested Key ID from Keychain.

methods.name: saveAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Stores the Attested Key ID into Keychain.

methods.name: clearAttestedKeyID
methods.description: Removes the Attested Key ID from Keychain.
